entries.root_cause: Job-level explicit YAML keys had been fail-closed, but step parsing still attempted to interpret explicit mapping syntax and therefore accepted a folded block-scalar key whose semantic value was `if`. A required governance step could be skipped while the authority validator remained green.

Supersession validation proved target existence and acyclicity but did not enforce the register's append-only replacement rule. An accepted decision could point backward to an older unrelated ID and falsely present it as the successor without appending a new replacement decision.
